items.prompt: Tool center follows segment [1, 1]→[1, 1]; inflated circular obstacle center=[4, 5], radius=1 m. Compute minimum center-to-segment distance. A zero-length segment is a point; touching counts as collision. This is geometry, not hardware clearance authorization. Tolerance ±0.001 for numeric fields; follow the stated units.
items.solution: If the segment has zero length, use point distance; otherwise clamp the scalar projection to [0,1]. Distance=5.0. Compare with the inflated radius separately; equality is collision.
